description: Regenerate a single target node in the stored flow session as a task-backed run. Requires MCP task augmentation; clients without it should call start_regenerate_asset_flow_node and poll get_asset_flow_task instead.

mode.description: mock = free dry run. live = paid provider generation — confirm with the user first.

sessionId.description: Persisted flow session id (flow_session_…) from create_asset_flow or list_asset_flows.

targetNodeId.description: Node to rerun from. An output node resolves to its generate producer and re-runs paid generation — never use this to fetch outputs (use get_flow_outputs).

name: regenerate_asset_flow_node
